title: Per-kernel six-axis feature vector
description: Closed-object schema for the per-kernel feature-vector sidecar emitted jointly by `nvbit_trace_summary_adapter.py::emit_kernel_feature_vector()` (axes 1, 2, 3, axis-5.predication_density, axis 6) and `static_sass_features.py` (axis 4, axis-5.register_usage). The composite artifact captures six structural axes that any simulator predicting the kernel's wall-clock or microarchitectural behavior must reproduce: (1) dynamic divergence profile, (2) memory-access stride distribution, (3) per-thread instruction count distribution, (4) static SASS mnemonic family histogram, (5) composite register-usage + predication-density axis with mixed static-dynamic claim semantics, (6) optional SMID migration count gated on tracer support. Each axis carries a `claim_class` enum that controls whether the axis can carry a load-bearing identifiability claim or only a structural sanity check; consumers that violate the claim_class constraint emit a typed `claim_uses_sanity_check_axis_only` diagnostic and the claim is rejected.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 over canonical kernel-signature inputs. It matches nvbit_trace_summary.schema.json for the same launch and, only when replaying retained pre-S4 dual-run evidence, the frozen CUPTI record validated by historical/cupti_activity_sidecar.v1.schema.json.

axes.description: The six structural axes. Required when `trace_budget_status == within_budget`; absent when `trace_budget_status == feature_vector_skipped_oversized_trace`.

trace_byte_count.description: Observed NVBit trace byte count that exceeded the per-kernel budget.

trace_budget_mib.description: Per-kernel trace byte-count budget in MiB at the time of the skip, mirroring `run_suite.py`'s `trace_budget_mib` setting.

diagnostic_token.description: Typed diagnostic token. Frozen at the value the closure plan's oversized-trace skip negative test enumerates.

trace_budget_status.description: Trace volume budget status. `within_budget` admits the record and requires the six axes; `feature_vector_skipped_oversized_trace` denotes the per-kernel byte-count budget was exceeded, the axes are absent, and the typed `skip_diagnostic` is present. The dichotomy is enforced by the schema's top-level `if/then/else` conditional.

buckets.description: Histogram of active-thread counts (0..32) per warp instruction. Indexed by population count of `instruction.proto.active_mask`. Length equals 33 buckets when bucket_size is 1; coarser when bucket_size > 1.

depth_histogram.description: Histogram of branch-reconvergence depth observed at execution time. Bucket 0 is no divergence; deeper buckets count branch nesting at the point an instruction executed.

stride_buckets_bytes.description: Stride bucket boundaries in bytes. Power-of-2 boundaries (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128+) by default.

stride_counts.description: Per-bucket counts of observed strides. Aligned with stride_buckets_bytes.

static_sass_features_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the corresponding static_sass_features.json sidecar. The composite-axis consumer reads the histogram from that sidecar; this axis is a structural pointer, not a data carrier, to keep the per-kernel feature-vector sidecar from duplicating static data already present in the static SASS sidecar.

register_usage.description: Static register-usage sub-field; sanity-check claim class only.

predicated_instruction_fraction.description: Dynamic fraction of issued instructions whose guard predicate evaluated true. Load-bearing claim class.

supported_by_tracer.description: True iff the active tracer build supports per-warp `%smid` migration tracking. When false, `migration_count` is absent and downstream consumers MUST treat the axis as not present rather than treating it as zero.

migration_count.description: Number of distinct SM ids a warp executed on across the launch lifetime, summed over all warps. Present only when supported_by_tracer is true.
